name: @margoengine/webgl2-compat
description: In development (milestones M0 to M4): the WebGL2 compatibility layer for browsers without WebGPU. install() gives core a WebGPU-shaped device on WebGL2 that translates WGSL to GLSL ES 3.00; render shaders, texture views, readbacks of every copyable format, occlusion queries, render bundles, external textures, gather and storage-buffer reads run; compute and storage writes come in later milestones.
author: Scott Campbell

scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node test/browser-check.mjs && node test/glsl-corpus-browser.mjs && cd ../.. && node packages/webgl2-compat/test/corpus-draw-browser.mjs
scripts.test:gpu: npm run build && cd ../.. && node packages/webgl2-compat/test/compat-browser-check.mjs && node packages/webgl2-compat/test/features-browser.mjs && node packages/materials/test/browser-check.mjs --compat && node packages/gltf-pro/scripts/test-shader-review.js --compat && node packages/lod/test/browser-check.mjs --compat && cd packages/lines && node scripts/test-browser.js --compat && cd ../points && node scripts/test-browser.js --compat && cd ../text && node scripts/test-browser.js --compat
